description: Search the FCA Financial Services Register by firm (or individual/fund) name and return ranked matches with FRN/IRN and a status summary. Example: fca_firm_search({ q: "Barclays Bank", type: "firm" })

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own FCA Register API credentials as "<email>:<key>" (the email you registered with, a colon, then the issued key). Omit it to use the Pipeworx key. Register free at https://register.fca.org.uk/Developer/s/registernewuser.

q.description: Name or substring to search for, e.g. "Barclays Bank".

type.description: Which register category to search. Default "firm".

name: fca_firm_search
title: Fca Firm Search
